channel.title: The Grant Desk - Cross-disciplinary & Social Impact, Remote & Worldwide, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Cross-disciplinary & Social Impact, Remote & Worldwide, weekly digest. Released weekly: each Sunday's drop carries one entry per grant added in the week before it (Sunday to Saturday). A call that closes before its drop goes out is not sent; the website lists those.

item.title: Lendhauer: Urban Ecologies - Coexistence and Control (Lendhafen, Klagenfurt 2027)
item.description: Lendhauer (Klagenfurt, Austria) · deadline 02 Nov 2026 · Artist fee up to EUR 2,500 gross, production costs up to EUR 4,000 gross (depending on project scope), and travel expenses up to EUR 1,000. No application fee.

item.title: Unearthodox Exploration Co-Lab 2027: Edges of Possibility
item.description: Unearthodox · deadline 16 Nov 2026 · CHF 10,000 grant per selected initiative, plus a 10-month incubation programme with tailored coaching, expert support, peer learning, systems mapping and futures-thinking support. No application fee.

item.title: Bertha Artivism Awards 2027
item.description: Bertha Foundation · deadline Rolling / undated · Up to USD 20,000 per one-year activist-art project. Free to apply.

item.title: Gulbenkian Institute for Advanced Study Fellowships 2027/28 (Lisbon)
item.description: Gulbenkian Institute for Advanced Study (GIAS), Calouste Gulbenkian Foundation · deadline 15 Oct 2026 · Up to 15 fellowships a year. Each covers travel costs, travel and health insurance, a monthly stipend and a partial housing subsidy; the stipend level is set at selection based on CV and length of stay. No application fee.

item.title: Onassis ONX: ONX Seeds 2026, Soft Circuits for Hard Times (Athens, hybrid)
item.description: Onassis ONX (Onassis Foundation) · deadline 26 Oct 2026 · EUR 1,000 to 5,000 seed funding per project, set by scope; up to four projects selected. Plus weekly technical, curatorial and business mentoring, online masterclasses, studio and equipment access at Onassis Ready for Athens-based teams, and presentation at ONX Exhibition Athens (17 to 21 March 2027) with travel, accommodation and artwork transport covered for non-Athens participants. No application fee.

item.title: Movies that Matter Festival 2027: Film Submissions
item.description: Movies that Matter · deadline 01 Nov 2026 · Cash prizes: EUR 5,000 Grand Jury Documentary award (winner also becomes eligible for consideration for the Academy Award for Best Documentary Feature), EUR 5,000 Grand Jury Fiction award, and EUR 1,500 Shorts award; further competitions (Activist Lens, Justice Frame, Dutch Focus, Education Award, Audience Award) publish no amounts. SUBMISSION FEE: EUR 25 until 30 September 2026, EUR 35 late fee 1 October to 1 November 2026; fee waivers only in very exceptional cases.

item.title: Nordic Culture Fund: ENTER 2026 (exploratory cross-border collaboration)
item.description: Nordic Culture Fund · deadline 16 Oct 2026 · Up to DKK 50,000 (roughly EUR 6,700), plus up to DKK 25,000 in additional accessibility support for logistics and access needs, for a maximum total of DKK 75,000. No co-funding required. No application fee.

item.title: Mycelia Fellowship 2026 (Social Resonance Lab)
item.description: Social Resonance Lab · deadline 13 Sep 2026 · USD 2,000 stipend per fellow; two fellows selected for the inaugural cohort

item.title: 1 new Cross-disciplinary & Social Impact grant - week of 24 Aug 2026
item.description:
• True Blue Fellowship 2027
    https://bowseat.org/programs/true-blue-fellowship/
    Bow Seat Ocean Awareness Programs · deadline 30 Aug 2026 · Up to USD 2,500 in project funding per fellow, plus mentorship and capacity-building programming. Twelve youth are selected annually. No application fee.

item.title: 1 new Cross-disciplinary & Social Impact grant - week of 17 Aug 2026
item.description:
• Ars Biologica ArtXScience Residency 2027-2028 (Ars Electronica x Ceske Budejovice ECoC 2028)
    https://ars.electronica.art/export/en/ecoc2028-ars-biologica-art-science-residency/
    Ars Electronica and Ceske Budejovice - European Capital of Culture 2028 · deadline 28 Sep 2026 · EUR 24,000 total package per winner: EUR 6,000 artist fee, up to EUR 15,000 production budget, and up to EUR 3,000 for travel, accommodation and subsistence, plus a separate budget covering one month of housing in Ceske Budejovice. Two positions available. Free to apply.

item.title: 1 new Cross-disciplinary & Social Impact grant - week of 20 Jul 2026
item.description:
• FUJIFILM GFX Challenge Grant Program 2026
    https://www.fujifilm-x.com/global/gfx-challenge-grant-program/year-2026/
    FUJIFILM · deadline 17 Aug 2026 · 5 Global Grant Awards of USD 10,000 and 10 Regional Grant Awards of USD 5,000. All recipients also get complimentary use of a GFX System camera body (including the FUJIFILM GFX ETERNA 55 filmmaking camera) and two GF lenses for the duration of the project, plus mentoring and technical assistance from Fujifilm technicians and product experts. Total approximate retail value of all awards: USD 229,500. No purchase necessary; no entry fee.

item.title: 5 new Cross-disciplinary & Social Impact grants - week of 06 Jul 2026
item.description:
• Chornobyl40: Open Call 2026 (Virtual Residency & International Exhibition)
    https://forms.gle/5btrxy7LwfY8QyFW6
    Chornobyl40 (gate22 / European Institute of Chornobyl consortium) · deadline 12 Jul 2026 · Residency is free to attend. For the 20 projects selected for production: EUR 500 grant for fully digital works or EUR 1,000 grant for installations requiring physical materials, plus inclusion in the international exhibition. Travel, accommodation, and transport are not covered. No application fee.
  • Ecoslay Mag: Open Call for Contributions, Issue 02 "The Urban Issue"
    https://ecoslay-mag.com/#open-call
    Ecoslay Mag · deadline 13 Jul 2026 · Financial compensation for selected contributions (amount unspecified). Editorial support, proofreading, and graphic design provided. No application fee.
  • Global Artivism: Governance Fellow
    https://www.abm-intelligence.com/governancefellow-globalartivism
    Global Artivism (a fiscally sponsored project of Res Publica US Inc.) · deadline 16 Jul 2026 · USD 1,200 to 1,800 per month (independent contractor fee), paid on receipt of monthly invoices. No employee benefits, paid leave, or insurance; contractor covers their own taxes and compliance.
  • Global Artivism: Operations Fellow
    https://www.abm-intelligence.com/operationsfellow-globalartivism
    Global Artivism (a fiscally sponsored project of Res Publica US Inc.) · deadline 16 Jul 2026 · USD 1,000 to 1,500 per month (independent contractor fee), paid on receipt of monthly invoices. No employee benefits, paid leave, or insurance; contractor covers their own taxes and compliance.
  • Connections Through Culture Grants 2026 (British Council)
    https://arts.britishcouncil.org/connections-through-culture
    British Council · deadline 12 Aug 2026 · Grants of between GBP 5,000 and GBP 15,000. Free to apply.
